verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents a REST API with stated full web-client parity, OAuth scopes and a downloadable OpenAPI spec. Zoho MCP connects Claude or GPT agents to Books to "pull reports just by asking" and "create financial reports", with Books-specific customer accounts of Claude-driven bookkeeping. Together these support an agent answering affordability questions from live ledger data. Missing for 10: explicitly documented report or cash-position endpoints (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) in the evidence, any example of an affordability or cash-runway style query, and independent hands-on corroboration beyond vendor pages; the MCP service is also sign-in-gated and unverified.
